model_annotation: The pie chart displays the distribution of news categories for children. The chart is divided into 8 slices, each representing a distinct category. The slices are labeled as follows: sports (21%), society (20%), model (19%), politics (14%), culture (14%), economy (6%), science (4%), and environmental protection (2%). A legend at the bottom of the chart provides a key to the colors used for each category. The chart does not feature any emphasized or highlighted slices, and the categories appear to be arranged in no specific order. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice.
